courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 卡里巴水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「高山集水與季節庫存」與「水化熱與拘束」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；卡里巴水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Alpine collection and seasonal storage" and "Hydration heat and restraint" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Kariba Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以大迪克桑斯重力壩高山集水與壩基監測學習；卡里巴水壩則以由卡里巴修復工程連結拱壩水墊沖蝕與閘門界面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on studying Grande Dixence gravity action alpine collection and foundation monitoring; Kariba Dam centres on connecting Kariba rehabilitation with arch action plunge-pool scour and gate interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「高山集水與季節庫存」與「拱作用與壩肩傳力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到卡里巴水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「圍堰抽排與水量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” and “Arch action and abutment transfer”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Kariba Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cofferdam dewatering balance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 壓力鋼管錨定與支承
related.transfer: 可遷移「高山集水與季節庫存」與「水化熱與拘束」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；壓力鋼管錨定與支承的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Alpine collection and seasonal storage" and "Hydration heat and restraint" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Penstock anchorage and supports must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以大迪克桑斯重力壩高山集水與壩基監測學習；壓力鋼管錨定與支承則以追蹤壓力、重量與溫度荷載如何經鋼管傳到錨塊支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on studying Grande Dixence gravity action alpine collection and foundation monitoring; Penstock anchorage and supports centres on trace pressure, gravity and thermal loads through penstocks into anchors and supports, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「高山集水與季節庫存」與「環向薄膜應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到壓力鋼管錨定與支承，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「跨距與梁式反力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” and “Circumferential membrane stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Penstock anchorage and supports, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Span and beam reactions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大迪克桑斯壩
history.text: 大迪克桑斯壩位於瑞士高山，業主資料確認其為285m高的重力壩，建設期為1951至1961年，並自1961年起啟用。業主另列原Dixence、Cleuson及後續擴建的不同階段，本課保持各壩與系統年代的區別，不將整體水電系統的高程差混同壩高。課程以自重、水壓、揚力、熱變形與廊道監測建立力學路徑，再連到高山集水與發電能量。全部計算採合成斷面及參數，未使用真實壩體剖面推定安全係數或現場狀態。
history.textEn: The owner identifies Grande Dixence as a285m gravity dam, built during1951–1961 and commissioned from1961. Its history distinguishes the original Dixence, Cleuson and later scheme phases, which are kept separate here. Scheme elevation difference is not dam height. Lessons connect weight, water pressure, uplift, thermal movement and gallery monitoring to alpine collection and generation. Synthetic sections and parameters do not assess the actual dam’s safety or present condition.

history.textEn: The course turns "Alpine collection and seasonal storage" through "High-head conveyance and net energy" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
